verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents real API versioning: the X-Appwrite-Response-Format header returns backward-compatible responses for a given version, and official OpenAPI/Swagger specs are published for every supported version. It also publishes a release policy with quarterly minor releases and two support phases (bug fixes plus security, then security-only), which works as a version lifecycle. However, no explicit deprecation policy for API endpoints or fields is shown, such as notice periods or sunset headers. Missing for 10: an explicit endpoint/field deprecation policy with notice timelines, sunset signaling in API responses, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Version number used for backward compatibility. The response will be formatted to be compatible with the provided version number.
